quotes.text: Add support for Revolut Pay to your integration.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: Make sure all `line_items` use the same currency.
the uncaptured PaymentIntent auto-expires 10 minutes after successful authorization.

findings: November 7 replaces expanded text with a variant selector. The Payment Element has explicit Checkout Sessions API and Payment Intents API navigation choices (new raw lines 9-21; old raw lines 110-115 and 129-176). Checkout, Direct API and all three mobile SDK routes remain discoverable. The variant bodies are not present.

Old raw line 2 establishes May 7, 2026 despite the filename. Source lines 4–7 date and attach the May detail. The navigation-only raw delta and necessary corrections to the May summary are independent findings.

Root index line 7 routes to Stripe index lines 409 and 684 for the acceptance source and Revolut Pay concept. The concept currently routes to the separate subscriptions guide (lines 8–10, 42–44); preserve it separately and route acceptance reciprocally. Provider index line 409 repeats the capture window and live-approval generalizations.
historical_claims_to_preserve: May Checkout documents same-currency line items, dynamic or manual selection, and recurring plans (old raw lines 12-40). Elements uses a server-created PaymentIntent and client-side confirmation (old raw lines 129-176 and 394-425); Direct API includes supported currency, client confirmation and optional manual redirect on requires_action (old raw lines 743-745, 830-925 and 946-953).

May Elements web mobile redirect and desktop QR use one-hour expiry and up to 20 desktop QR refreshes (old raw lines 607-622). Distinguish browser return from inspected intent status and Stripe's payment_intent.succeeded event (old raw lines 490-545 and 671-675), failure/timeout fallback (old raw lines 705-712), and capture after authorization (old raw lines 623-670).

May native SDK guides use backend PaymentIntents and platform-specific confirmation and callbacks (old raw lines 1054-1183, 1350-1450 and 1618-1776). Preserve the test-mode timing and platform return-URL distinctions.
conflicts: May React Native general manual capture is seven days at old raw lines 1778-1787; React Native test mode is ten minutes after successful authorization at old raw lines 1841-1849. May iOS and Android test mode say seven days at old raw lines 1248-1254 and 1514-1520.

May Android describes native Revolut app authentication at old raw line 1284 and PaymentLauncher webview at line 1408. Distinguish SDK descriptions without asserting an invariant UI. May native iOS describes custom scheme or universal link (1110–1144), while React Native's iOS-only setup excludes universal links (1679–1689).
unresolved_questions: The November variant bodies are uncaptured; the selector does not verify current path-specific behavior or resolve May platform wording and capture timing.

findings: Source lines 21–29 compress the May Elements web flow and manual capture without variant/environment qualifiers. Scope redirects, QR, 20 refreshes and live-mode testing auto-approval to the May Elements passages (old raw lines 607-622 and 691-701) and retain the manual-capture expiry discrepancy.

Source lines 13–19 accurately identify six May variants and Checkout recurring support. Preserve May Checkout's same-currency Session prerequisite and dynamic/manual choice (old raw lines 12-40); source line 31 is the May Elements error table (old raw lines 715-722), with three codes shown in each native variant.

Source lines 21–29 should distinguish May Elements mobile-web authentication prose, which says customers approve or decline and return (old raw lines 609-622), from the web testing section's live-mode descriptions of automatic approval after mobile redirection or desktop QR scan and sandbox approve/decline controls (old raw lines 691-701). Preserve both dated contexts without promoting either to general live approval or a successful-payment guarantee.

Source lines 21–29 do not give a reader a safe fulfillment boundary. Old raw line 620 pairs QR modal closure after successful authentication with fulfillment wording, but old raw lines 490-545 distinguish return/status display and old raw lines 671-675 direct business actions to Stripe's payment_intent.succeeded event rather than a client callback. QR closure, app return or a client callback alone does not establish payment success. Manual authorization separately reaches requires_capture before a capture request (old raw lines 623-670).
conflicts: May React Native general manual capture is seven days at old raw lines 1778-1787; React Native test mode is ten minutes after successful authorization at old raw lines 1841-1849. May iOS and Android test mode say seven days at old raw lines 1248-1254 and 1514-1520.

May Android describes native Revolut app authentication at old raw line 1284 and PaymentLauncher webview at line 1408. Distinguish SDK descriptions without asserting an invariant UI. May native iOS describes custom scheme or universal link (1110–1144), while React Native's iOS-only setup excludes universal links (1679–1689).
source_assessments.reason: Qualify May web authentication and testing by variant and environment, preserve the distinction between authentication and provider-confirmed payment outcome before fulfillment, and document capture-window differences. Link November navigation alongside the May raw and existing Revolut Pay concept.

answers.Q1: The 2026-11-07 capture of https://docs.stripe.com/payments/revolut-pay/accept-a-payment identifies Revolut Pay acceptance and links Checkout, Elements with Checkout Sessions or Payment Intents APIs, Direct API, and iOS, Android and React Native (new raw lines 5-21). The selector supplies no variant prerequisites, actors or states. The 2026-05-07 guide calls for existing Checkout setup and same-currency line items, and describes dynamic or manual selection and recurring plans (old raw lines 12-40). Elements and Direct API use a merchant server-created PaymentIntent, client confirmation and buyer authentication, with an optional manual redirect on requires_action in Direct API (old raw lines 129-176 and 830-925). The May Elements sections distinguish browser return from verified status and Stripe payment events. Decline or one hour of inaction after redirect from requires_action detaches the PaymentMethod and returns the intent to requires_payment_method. Successful manual authorization yields requires_capture and requires separate capture (old raw lines 607-712). source-stripe-revolut-pay-accept-payment.md lines 13–31 broadly summarizes these May variants but generalizes Elements web testing and capture timing.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/revolut-pay/accept-a-payment, November adds presentational and navigational changes, including separate Elements Checkout Sessions API and Payment Intents API routes (new raw lines 9-21). It establishes no substantive payment-behavior change or retirement. Preserve the May guide in source-stripe-revolut-pay-accept-payment.md. Its same-currency Checkout line items are a prerequisite, and recurring plans are supported (old raw lines 21-40). The May Elements mobile-web flow says customers approve or decline, while its testing section offers sandbox approve/decline controls and describes live-mode auto-approval after mobile redirect or desktop QR scan (old raw lines 609-622 and 691-701). Keep those dated contexts with their differing wording. The May desktop QR passage mentions fulfillment after successful authentication and modal closure, while the return page checks intent status and the webhook section directs fulfillment and other business actions to Stripe's payment_intent.succeeded event rather than a client callback (old raw lines 490-545, 607-622 and 671-675). Manual authorization reaches requires_capture and still requires capture (old raw lines 623-670). Retain the React Native test-mode ten-minute expiry alongside its seven-day general passage (old raw lines 1778-1849), the May iOS and Android test-mode seven-day statements (old raw lines 1248-1254 and 1514-1520), and the Android app/webview wording discrepancy. Keep the reciprocal acceptance route with the Revolut Pay concept distinct from the subscriptions guide, and preserve the detailed May raw alongside the November selector.
